prompt: From high above, the boxy grey robot with its amber roof light rolls gently up the empty road at an easy strolling pace. The aerial camera glides along with it at exactly that slow pace, so the robot stays put just below the centre of the picture while the wrecked terraced houses and rubble slide down the screen only slightly over the whole shot. Unhurried and steady. Sharp clean modern drone footage, smooth tones. The camera holds its height and angle throughout, no zoom, no tilt; only the amber light pulses.
